query: Which is hotter, Mercury or Venus?
answer:
Venus is hotter, even though Mercury is closer to the Sun. Venus's average surface temperature is about 464°C (867°F). That makes it the hottest planet in the Solar System. Mercury's average is only about 167°C (333°F) [1]. The difference comes from Venus's very thick atmosphere, which is about 96.5% carbon dioxide and roughly 90 times as dense as Earth's. It creates a runaway greenhouse effect that keeps the whole planet hot enough to melt lead, day and night [2][3]. Mercury has almost no atmosphere, so its heat escapes into space. Its sunlit side gets very hot, but its night side falls to about −180°C (−290°F) [2].

Sources:
[1] NASA Science, "Temperatures Across Our Solar System": https://science.nasa.gov/solar-system/temperatures-across-our-solar-system/
